name: Head of Overseer Maltorius
summary: The Head of Overseer Maltorius is proof of a bounty in the Searing Gorge. Lookout Captain Lolo Longstriker asks you to bring it back from the Cauldron.

sections.title: A Bounty in the Gorge
sections.body: Lookout Captain Lolo Longstriker offers a bounty on Maltorius, a Dark Iron dwarf who commands the Slag Pit crew in the Cauldron. The order names him a rogue Thorium Brotherhood agent. His severed head is the proof Longstriker asks you to bring back from the depths of the Slag Pit.

faq.answer: Overseer Maltorius was a Dark Iron dwarf and commander of the Slag Pit crew in the Cauldron. The bounty calls him a rogue Thorium Brotherhood agent.
Maltorius is deep within the Slag Pit in the Cauldron, in the Searing Gorge.
The bounty order calls Maltorius a rogue Thorium Brotherhood agent and orders his death.
Lookout Captain Lolo Longstriker offers the bounty and asks you to bring back Maltorius's head as proof.

faq.q: What is the Head of Overseer Maltorius?
faq.answer: It is Maltorius's severed head, taken as proof of the bounty in the Searing Gorge.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you face a Dark Iron commander in the Slag Pit, where his crew works in the Cauldron.
